scope: Registered-Git-only Project-Srednicki-Weinberg coefficient dictionary for pure N=1, N=2, and N=4 super Yang-Mills

checks.detail: Every displayed Srednicki and Weinberg locator resolves to the registered vendored page snapshot and its source-ledger page id.
The Project absorbed basis, Srednicki basis, Weinberg hatted basis, invariant trace metric, and four-component gaugino rescaling are separated explicitly.
No unsupported identification between a Project Weyl spinor and Weinberg's four-component Majorana spinor is made.
Every N=2 and N=4 textbook cell is SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT because the registered snapshots do not fix those rules.
The Project cell is PASS_EXACT_GENERAL_LIE_CLOSURE from the color-free Lorentzian and Euclidean PBW-word verifier; both textbook cells remain SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT.
NOT_DEFINED_IN_SOURCE is restricted to intrinsic Euclidean superspace; Euclidean components and currents are SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT.

resolved_findings.issue: The first table draft could be read as a direct Project-Weyl to Weinberg-Majorana field equality.
resolved_findings.resolution: The final table keeps the spinor representations typed and records only the source-supported four-component rescaling.

resolved_findings.issue: The first Euclidean source-status partition did not distinguish absent intrinsic Euclidean superspace from insufficient component evidence.
resolved_findings.resolution: The final dictionary uses NOT_DEFINED_IN_SOURCE only for intrinsic Euclidean superspace and SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT for components and currents.
